summary: Phase 2 AI Trading Bot — comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing. 20/20 backend pytest cases passed against /api/trading/* surface. Frontend /admin/my-trading renders correctly, all data-testids present, settings save flow persists end-to-end. No critical bugs found.

issues: Bilingual title overlap: 'My Smart Portfolio' (EN) renders on the right while '📈 محفظتي الذكية' (AR) renders on the left of the same line — visually cluttered. Consider showing one per active locale.

Halal whitelist is enforced BEFORE Alpaca connection check on /trade, /quote, /ai-suggest — verified correct.
Owner JWT guard accepts 'owner', 'admin', 'superuser' roles — confirmed via /api/auth/login with owner@zerax.com.
Alpaca creds validated against Alpaca /v2/account BEFORE persisting — confirmed (FAKE/FAKE returns 400).
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from /recent-trades, /ai-suggestions, /settings responses.
Cooldown + daily-loss circuit-breaker logic is in place but cannot be E2E tested without real Alpaca creds (per request, this is expected).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows without Alpaca creds
